subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella before more automated fixes are queued?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable completion spool/outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

options.title: Narrow to the linked retry PR
options.body: Treat the linked open PR as the near-term patch only after conflicts, real behavior proof, and retry duplicate-safety risks are resolved.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Close or demote the umbrella only after each remaining failure mode is moved to a clearly owned narrower issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable completion spool/outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined feature-history signal around subagent lifecycle and delivery ownership.
